title: data/balance.json still carries a default_budget field the sim no longer consumes
detail: The Balance struct (core/catalog.odin:82) has no default_budget field and no .odin reads it; the field-by-field parser (catalog.odin:353+) silently drops it. Dead data left by the budget->inventory rename (user ruling, commit 0b92fa4).
recommended_fix: Delete the default_budget line from data/balance.json. Optionally add a balance.json unknown-key rejection test (the r1 'unknown keys accepted' note).

title: HUD docstring still lists 'budget' among what the HUD renders
evidence: // SLA chips, budget, forecast ("weather report"), alerts, and the win/lose
detail: The budget system was removed (commit 0b92fa4) and replaced by the hardware tray/inventory. The docstring still names 'budget', so it no longer matches what draw_tray actually renders.
recommended_fix: Replace 'budget' in the hud.odin docstring with 'hardware tray' (or 'inventory') so the comment matches draw_tray.

title: draw_and_upgrade.dem header says demolish refunds 'into the budget'
evidence: # over-span upgrade rejection (Perkins r1), demolish refunds into the budget.
detail: Demolish now refunds hardware to the inventory/tray, not a budget (budget removed in 0b92fa4). This is a distinct demo from the r1-carried draw_and_reject.dem; its header prose is stale.
recommended_fix: Reword the draw_and_upgrade.dem header to 'demolish refunds into the tray' to match the inventory system.

title: project-context.md still describes game/ as a present reference build after its removal
evidence: - **Reference build:** `game/` is the frozen Godot prototype — behavioral reference only; never ported line-by-line, never extended.
detail: game/ is removed in this PR (commit 0df9135) and preserved only at the prototype-fun-gate tag. README:8-10 documents that; project-context.md:30 does not, so it implies game/ is in the working tree.
recommended_fix: Update project-context.md:30 to state game/ lives at the prototype-fun-gate tag (mirroring README:8-10), not in the tree.
